provenance.description: Original six declaration trace failures plus raw FF/FE, C/installed C.utf8, quote/empty/failure/wrapper/side-effect-once controls; exact complete streams/status/effects

cases.name: declaration assignments show expanded values
cases.stdin:
value=world
set -x
declare declared=$value
export exported=$value
readonly fixed=$value
function f() {
  local local_value=$value
}
f
set +x

cases.name: wrappers trace the full invocation for declaration targets
cases.stdin:
value=world
set -x
command declare a=$value
builtin declare b=$value
command builtin declare c=$value
builtin command declare d=$value
command export e=$value
set +x

cases.name: export and readonly echo assignments but not bare names
cases.stdin:
set -x
export a=1 b=2
readonly c=3 d
declare e=4
typeset t=5
f() { local g=6 h; }
f
set +x

cases.name: export and readonly echo assignments recognized from strings
assignment operands are traced as single quoted words
cases.stdin:
v="a b"
set -x
declare sp="$v"
export esp="$v"
readonly rsp="$v"
set +x

cases.name: compound assignment operands are traced as two lines
cases.stdin:
set -x
declare -a b=(1 2)
declare -A c=([k]=v)
export ea=(1 2)
readonly ra=(1 2)
set +x
set -x; declare -a a=($'\xff\xfe' "a b" $'a\'b'); declare -A b=([$'\xff']=$'\xfe')
set -x; readonly x=old; readonly x=new; export x=new; readonly "bad-name=value"; export "bad-name=value"; :
declare -i n=1; set -x; export n="n+1"; readonly n="n+1"; :
set -x; export x=; readonly y=; declare z=; v=''; export ev=$v

set -x
declare value="$(printf x >>once; printf 'a b')"
declare -a arr=($(printf y >>once; printf 'one two'))
set +x
printf '<%s>\n' "$value" "${arr[@]}"; cat once
i=0; set -x; declare -a a=([i++]=value); export n=$((i++)); readonly r=$((i++)); set +x; printf 'count:%s\n' "$i"
set -x; command declare -a a=(one two); command readonly r=one; builtin export b='two words'; set +x
set -x; readonly 'bad-name=one' ok=two; export 'bad-name2=three' yes=four; set +x; printf '<%s>\n' "$ok" "$yes"
